morphology_as_written: the morphology of a cauliflower, consisting of rod-like particles aggregated into a cauliflower shape
notes: Sample Mg-MOF-74-N0. 0.674 g H4DOBDC (3.4 mmol) and 2.8 g Mg(NO3)2·6H2O (10.9 mmol) in 300 mL; metal_conc_mM computed from these. Stirred only until dissolved, then static in a crystallisation kettle. CO2 uptake 1.62 mmol/g (co2_adsorption.csv).

morphology_as_written: the size of the cauliflower particles was decreased to 13 um after adding 0.5 equivalent amounts of NaAc
notes: Sample Mg-MOF-74-N0.5. The paper does not say what the NaAc 'equivalent' is counted against. XRD peak intensity falls as NaAc rises (lower crystallinity).

morphology_as_written: Mg-MOF-74-N1 mainly presented rod-like particles, and the length and the diameter of rod particles were 5 um and 1 um
Mg-MOF-74-N2 still had rod-like particles with a diameter of about 3 um and a uniform distribution, and the diameter of the particles was about 400 nm
size_basis: particle diameter as given in the abstract
notes: Sample Mg-MOF-74-N2. The results text gives two different sizes in one sentence (3 um and 400 nm); the abstract and conclusions say nanometre-sized rods of about 400 nm, which is the value entered. BET area and pore volume higher than N0; H3 hysteresis indicates inter-particle mesopores. CO2 uptake 3.63 mmol/g (co2_adsorption.csv).
